name: Mono Bass
author: Motion Audio
description: Puts everything below a frequency in the middle and leaves the rest as wide as it was: a tight, centred low end that's safe on mono speakers and subwoofers.
code:
@block
k = 1 - exp(-2 * pi * freq / srate)
@sample
a1 += (inL - a1) * k + 1e-20
a2 += (a1 - a2) * k
b1 += (inR - b1) * k + 1e-20
b2 += (b1 - b2) * k
lo = (a2 + b2) * 0.5
hl = inL - a2
hr = inR - b2
m = (hl + hr) * 0.5
s = (hl - hr) * 0.5 * width
outL = lo + m + s
outR = lo + m - s
